_doc: The dated event registry (G12, 2026-10-13). THE one place to add a Google update or a data break: build_v4.py inlines it into v5/code/_annotations.js and v5/code/_site_stats.js and writes app/shared/src/seo-events.generated.ts for the app's charts. Add an entry, rebuild, done. Dates are the start and the end of the rollout as Google announced it (Google Search Status dashboard); an event still rolling out keeps today's date as its end.

data_breaks.name: num=100 stopped working
data_breaks.detail: Google stopped serving 100 results on one page in mid-September 2025, so the SEO tools that read 100 results at a time disappeared from the counts. Impressions fell and average position improved on most sites without anything changing on the site: figures from before and after this break are not comparable.
